#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "pico/stdlib.h"
#include "hardware/adc.h"
#include "pir.h"
#include "sound.h"
#include "mic.h"
#include "DHT22.h"
#include "weather_tree.h"
#include "lora.h"

#define LIGHT_ADC_PIN 27 // Light AO connected to GP27 (ADC1)

static uint16_t audio_buffer[NUM_SAMPLES];

int main() {
    stdio_init_all();
    sleep_ms(3000);

    printf("=== Fully Integrated Edge Node (Audio + Weather + LoRa) ===\n");

    // Initialize Audio & Motion Subsystems
    pir_init();
    sound_init();
    mic_init();

    // Initialize Environmental Sensors & LoRa
    DHT_init();
    adc_gpio_init(LIGHT_ADC_PIN);
    lora_init();

    float temperature = 0.0f;
    float humidity = 0.0f;
    uint32_t last_env_read = 0;
    uint16_t event_counter = 0;

    while (true) {
        uint32_t current_time = to_ms_since_boot(get_absolute_time());

        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        // 1. Routine Environmental Telemetry (Every 2 seconds)
        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        if (current_time - last_env_read >= 2000) {
            last_env_read = current_time;

            adc_select_input(1); // Select GP27 (ADC1) for Light Sensor
            uint16_t light_raw = adc_read();

            if (DHT_read(&temperature, &humidity)) {
                float env_features[3] = {temperature, humidity, (float)light_raw};
                int weather_pred = weather_predict(env_features);

                printf("[ENV] Temp: %.1f C | Hum: %.1f%% | Light: %d | Weather: %s\n",
                       temperature, humidity, light_raw, weather_label(weather_pred));
            }
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        // 2. Dual-Trigger Audio Capture (PIR Motion + Sound Noise)
        // ---------------------------------------------------------
        if (sound_is_triggered() && pir_is_motion_detected()) {
            event_counter++;
            printf("\n[ALERT] Dual Trigger Fired! Event #%d. Recording 5s Audio...\n", event_counter);

            // Record 5 seconds of audio on GP26 (ADC0)
            adc_select_input(0);
            mic_record_buffer(audio_buffer, NUM_SAMPLES);

            SoundAnalysis audio_analysis = mic_analyze_buffer(audio_buffer, NUM_SAMPLES);

            // Read Light Sensor again for combined event snapshot
            adc_select_input(1);
            uint16_t current_light = adc_read();
            float env_features[3] = {temperature, humidity, (float)current_light};
            int weather_pred = weather_predict(env_features);

            // Transmit compact 16-byte packet over LoRa mesh
            LoRaMeshPacket packet;
            packet.node_id       = 1;
            packet.event_id      = event_counter;
            packet.sound_class   = (uint8_t)audio_analysis.class_id;
            packet.sound_energy  = (uint16_t)audio_analysis.energy;
            packet.weather_class = (uint8_t)weather_pred;
            packet.temp_c_x10    = (int16_t)(temperature * 10.0f);
            packet.humidity_x10  = (uint16_t)(humidity * 10.0f);
            packet.light_raw     = current_light;

            printf("[LORA] Transmitting 16-byte telemetry packet...\n");
            lora_send_packet((uint8_t *)&packet, sizeof(LoRaMeshPacket));

            // Print JSON metadata header over USB Serial
            printf("JSON_HEADER:{\"node\":1,\"event\":%d,\"weather\":\"%s\",\"sound\":{\"class\":%d,\"energy\":%.1f},\"pcm_bytes\":%d}\n",
                   event_counter, weather_label(weather_pred), audio_analysis.class_id, audio_analysis.energy, NUM_SAMPLES * 2);
            stdio_flush();

            // Stream raw PCM audio in 512-byte USB blocks to prevent CDC timeout
            uint8_t *raw_bytes = (uint8_t *)audio_buffer;
            size_t total_bytes = NUM_SAMPLES * sizeof(uint16_t);
            size_t bytes_sent = 0;

            while (bytes_sent < total_bytes) {
                size_t chunk_size = (total_bytes - bytes_sent > 512) ? 512 : (total_bytes - bytes_sent);
                for (size_t i = 0; i < chunk_size; i++) {
                    putchar_raw(raw_bytes[bytes_sent + i]);
                }
                stdio_flush();
                bytes_sent += chunk_size;
                sleep_us(100); // Brief pacing delay for USB CDC driver
            }

            printf("\n[COMPLETE] Cooldown for 5 seconds...\n\n");
            sleep_ms(5000); // PIR sensor settlement cooldown
        }

        sleep_ms(10);
    }

    return 0;
}
